# NEXVORA

> NEXVORA is a technology solutions company based in Egypt. It designs, builds, and optimizes digital products, marketing systems, and business technology for organizations worldwide, with access to a talent pool in Egypt and the US.

NEXVORA offers software development, SaaS products, IT infrastructure, digital marketing and advertising, consultations, and training.

## Services
- [Tech Talent](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/tech-talent/): Access to engineering talent in Egypt and the US to fit an organization's technology and business needs.
- [Product Engineering](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/product-engineering/): Design and engineering of digital products.
- [Web design & Development](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/web-development/): Websites and web applications, including CMS and PHP work.
- [Page Speed Optimization](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/page-speed-optimization/): Improving website loading performance.
- [Mobile Applications](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/mobile-applications/): Android and iOS applications.
- [WordPress and Shopify](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/wordpress-and-shopify/): WordPress and Shopify websites and stores.
- [Digital Marketing](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/digital-marketing-advertising/): Data-driven digital marketing and advertising.
- [Brand Identity & Graphic Design](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/brand-identity-graphic-design/): Brand identity and graphic design.
- [IT Infrastructure](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/it-infrastructure/): Cloud and IT infrastructure for performance, connectivity, security, and operations.
- [Managed Hosting Services](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/managed-hosting-services/): Managed hosting.
- [Cybersecurity & Recovery Service](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/cybersecurity-recovery-service/): Security, SSL, monitoring, and recovery.
- [AI Consultation](https://nexvoraagency.com/service/ai-consultation/): AI consulting.
